Package edu.cnu.mdi.splot.fit

Class PolynomialFitter

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.fit.ALeastSquaresFitter
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.fit.PolynomialFitter
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFitStringGetter, IFitter
public final class PolynomialFitter extends ALeastSquaresFitter implements IFitter
Polynomial least-squares fitter using Apache Commons Math 3.x least-squares API.

Model: 

   y(x) = c0 + c1 x + c2 x^2 + ... + cN x^N

Returned parameter ordering: 

 params[k] = c_k

Initial guess

If the caller does not supply an initial guess, the fitter computes a weighted linear least-squares solution (via LinearLeastSquaresGuesser) which is an excellent starting point (often already the solution) for polynomials.

    • fit

      public FitResult fit(double[] x, double[] y, double[] weights, PolynomialFitter.ParameterBounds bounds, double[] initialGuess)
      Fit with optional weights, bounds, and explicit initial guess.

      This is an "expert" overload that adapts polynomial coefficient bounds to the base class ParameterValidator mechanism.

      Parameters:
      x - x data
      y - y data
      weights - optional weights (length n). Typically weights = 1/sigmaY^2.
      bounds - optional coefficient bounds; if null, unbounded
      initialGuess - optional coefficients length degree+1; if null, uses default guess
      Returns:
      FitResult
